description:
As an Associate NOC Support Engineer, you will support the engineering and operations teams in monitoring, maintaining, and optimizing the performance of ExpressVPN’s global network. This role is ideal for early-career professionals passionate about networking technologies, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity principles. You will gain hands-on experience with real-world systems and tools that power an international VPN service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in monitoring network health, performance, and availability across ExpressVPN’s global infrastructure.

  • Respond to alerts and assist in identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving network incidents.

  • Collaborate with senior engineers to document standard operating procedures (SOPs) and incident playbooks.

  • Participate in on-call rotations and contribute to after-hours incident response as needed.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field.

Technical Skills

  • Good understanding of networking concepts.

  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools (e.g., Nagios, Zabbix, Grafana) or willingness to learn.

  • Comfortable working with Linux/Unix systems.

  • Exposure to cloud environments (AWS or GCP) is desirable.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to work well in a team and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

  • Eagerness to learn in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

What You’ll Gain

  • Hands-on experience with global network operations for a high-performance distributed service.

  • Mentorship from experienced network and systems engineers.

  • Exposure to industry-leading tools and technologies in network monitoring and cloud infrastructure.

  • Career growth opportunities within ExpressVPN’s technical organization.
